name: Ludmilla
description: The other gorgon in Vraska's youth prison cell, who is killed by an Azorius guard while comforting the Golgari prisoners.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
timeline.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.
